cs.t: I own a Pinetime, and I agree it's close to the Pebble (I used to own a Pebble Steel).  My Pinetime gets around 3ish days battery life, usage dependent. I wanted a watch that I could control my media player on my phone with, gave me notifications, and didn't cost me an appendage.  The Pinetime was $35USD shipped (IIRC), and while I can't dismiss phone notifications from my watch, it does at least show me the notifications from my wrist.  I'm very happy with mine.
cs.th: Over 16k people still use a Pebble smartwatch
